summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Operations (Operaciones) feature. All 10 test requirements passed. Backend API endpoints working correctly with gerente attribution. Frontend Operations page displays correctly on desktop and mobile with all required columns, filters, and export functionality.
passed_tests: 1. Operations page navigation - Menu shows 'Operaciones' link between 'Inicio' and 'Configuración'
2. Operations page loads correctly at /operations route
3. Operations table displays all required columns: Fecha, Cliente, Tarjeta, Operación, Monto, Saldo, Compra, Gerente, Nota
4. Gerente field is populated correctly with scanner app user's name (Demo Usuario, Demo User)
5. Filters panel opens/closes when clicking 'Filtros' button
6. Filters include: Date range (start/end), Gerente dropdown, Operation type dropdown
7. CSV export downloads file with correct Spanish headers (operaciones_2026-01-26.csv)
8. XLSX export downloads Excel file with correct Spanish headers (operaciones_2026-01-26.xlsx)
9. Transaction logging - add-stamp action creates operation record with gerente attribution
10. Comment sent to Boomerangme includes [Gerente: Name] prefix (verified in code)
Backend: GET /api/operations returns operations list with pagination
Backend: GET /api/operations supports date range filtering
Backend: GET /api/operations supports gerente filtering
Backend: GET /api/operations supports operation type filtering
Backend: GET /api/operations/export?format=csv returns CSV with Spanish headers
Backend: GET /api/operations/export?format=xlsx returns Excel file
Backend: GET /api/operations/summary returns summary statistics
Backend: Operations endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
Backend: Operation records have correct structure with all required fields
Frontend: Mobile view shows card-based layout with gerente info
Frontend: Filters panel works on mobile
Frontend: Export buttons visible and functional on mobile
seed_data_creation: Operations created via API testing: add-stamp actions on DEMO-001 and 820551-447-797 cards
context_for_next_testing_agent: Operations feature fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/operations (list with filters), GET /api/operations/export (CSV/XLSX), GET /api/operations/summary. All card action endpoints (add-stamp, subtract-reward, add-point, etc.) now log operations with gerente attribution. Comments sent to Boomerangme API include [Gerente: Name] prefix. Mobile view uses card-based layout, desktop uses table. Spanish UI throughout.
mocked_api_note: DEMO-* cards use MOCK data for demo purposes. Real card 820551-447-797 uses live Boomerangme API.
